units.source_text: 两人如此戏谑，足见交情甚深。

en.t: The way the two of them joked like this showed how deep their friendship was.

units.source_text: 谈到最近详情，匂亲王首先探询宇治山庄之事：“大女公子故后情况如何？”

en.t: When they came to recent events in detail, Prince Niou first asked about the villa at Uji: "How have things been since the elder young lady passed away?"

units.source_text: 薰中纳言便向他历叙近几月来无穷的悲哀以及从那天直到今日思念不绝的苦况，

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, then recounted to him at length the endless grief of the past several months and the pain of longing that had not ceased from that day until now,

units.source_text: 又诉说时时触景生情而回忆起来的种种哀乐，

en.t: and he also spoke of the many sorrowful and joyful memories that returned whenever some scene stirred his feelings,

units.source_text: 真如世人所谓带泣带笑，说得淋漓尽致。

en.t: truly speaking, as people say, through both tears and laughter, and pouring everything out without reserve.

units.source_text: 何况匂亲王秉性多情，容易流泪，

en.t: Moreover, Prince Niou was by nature deeply feeling and easily moved to tears,

units.source_text: 即使是别人的事，也要哭得衣袖上绞出水来，

en.t: so even over another person's affairs he would weep until water could be wrung from his sleeves,

units.source_text: 听了他这番话之后，对他表示无限的同情。

en.t: and after hearing this account, he showed him boundless sympathy.
